name: Acetic Acid Water 0.6%
storage: Store at 2-8 °C, protected from light; do not freeze.
definition: Acetic Acid Water 0.6% (AA06) is a laboratory solvent supplied as sterile solution. The catalogue lists 2 pack sizes: 3 ml, 10 ml. Grade and composition are stated on the lot-specific certificate of analysis. Each kit contains 10 vials; minimum order quantity is 1 kit. Store the sterile solution at 2-8 °C, protected from light. Documentation includes a lot-specific certificate of analysis. For laboratory research use only; not for human or veterinary use.

faq.question: What documentation is supplied with Acetic Acid Water 0.6%?
faq.answer: Every batch of Acetic Acid Water 0.6% is released against a lot-specific certificate of analysis (COA) that records the product identity, grade, appearance and the batch number. The COA for the lot you receive is available on request.

faq.question: How should Acetic Acid Water 0.6% be stored?
faq.answer: Keep at 2–8 °C away from light. The AA06 solution is not designed for freezing; in-use duration is stated per lot on the COA.

faq.question: What pack sizes are available for Acetic Acid Water 0.6%?
faq.answer: Acetic Acid Water 0.6% is stocked in 2 pack sizes (3 mL, 10 mL), 10 vials per kit, MOQ 1 kit. At 1–9 kits the per-kit price is $15.00; 10–49 kits falls to $13.80 (−8%) and 50+ to $12.76 (−15%).
